caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical hat box with a removable lid, predominantly featuring an ornate floral and scroll pattern. The background of the box is a pale beige or cream color, overlaid with intricate gold scrollwork. Among the scrollwork, clusters of large, pink and red flowers with green leaves are scattered, along with occasional blue and white floral and decorative motifs. Around the edge of the lid, there is a bold, narrow red band with a repeating motif of red leaves or petals, bordered by thin black lines. The interior of the lid visible at the top shares the same gold scrollwork and floral pattern as the exterior. The objects in the drawing are rendered with careful shading to suggest dimension and texture, and the composition is centered on the single hat box against an unadorned, light background. Handwritten text is present near the left edge of the paper.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
